input_fields.name: visible_edge
input_fields.description: One visible edge and intended edge-loop identity.

input_fields.name: navigation_mapping
input_fields.description: Verified double-click mapping or an explicit loop-selection equivalent.

result_fields.name: edge_loop_selection
result_fields.description: Selected loop member identities, target edge, and direct/equivalent control used.

procedure: Set the edge filter and pre-highlight visible_edge.
Perform one calibrated double left click, or use one verified loop-selection menu/mode when double-click is unavailable.
Observe the highlighted loop and return edge_loop_selection with the actual control path.
If the result is not a loop, stop rather than repeating clicks blindly.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous edge/loop, unsupported double click without equivalent, or a result that spans an unintended topology region.
Do not assume double click is cross-version invariant.
